[compiler:gccgo] skip

# End-to-end test that cmd/go normalizes -dst. compiler -V=full buildIDs to
# contentID:
#   1. Matching contentID across distinct actionIDs (stage-2 vs stage-3
#      bootstrap) hits GOCACHE.
#   2. Changed contentID at the same goX.Y.Z-dst.N version string (reinstalled
#      compiler via `task compiler`) invalidates GOCACHE without `go clean -cache`.

# Build the -toolexec wrapper using the harness's warm stdlib cache first.
go build -o $WORK/wrap${GOEXE} ./wrap

# Isolate GOCACHE for the target package builds.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env COMPILE_LOG=$WORK/compile.log
mkdir $GOCACHE

# Cold build: compiler must run once for zero-import package p.
env FAKE_BUILD_ID=actA/mainA/cnt1
go build -toolexec=$WORK/wrap${GOEXE} ./p
exists $COMPILE_LOG
rm $COMPILE_LOG

# Same contentID (cnt1) with a different actionID (actB/mainB): cache hit.
env FAKE_BUILD_ID=actB/mainB/cnt1
go build -toolexec=$WORK/wrap${GOEXE} ./p
! exists $COMPILE_LOG

# New contentID (cnt2) at the identical -dst. version string: cache miss.
env FAKE_BUILD_ID=actC/mainC/cnt2
go build -toolexec=$WORK/wrap${GOEXE} ./p
exists $COMPILE_LOG

-- go.mod --
module example.com/dstcache

go 1.26

-- p/p.go --
package p

func F() int { return 42 }

-- wrap/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	tool := os.Args[1]
	args := os.Args[2:]
	base := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(tool), ".exe")
	if base == "compile" && len(args) == 1 && args[0] == "-V=full" {
		fmt.Printf("compile version go1.27.4-dst.16 buildID=%s\n", os.Getenv("FAKE_BUILD_ID"))
		return
	}
	if base == "compile" {
		if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("COMPILE_LOG"), []byte("compiled\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
			os.Exit(2)
		}
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(tool, args...)
	cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		if ee, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
			os.Exit(ee.ExitCode())
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
